name: ai-news-dashboard
initializeCommand: $d = '${localWorkspaceFolder}/../.secrets'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; $f = "$d/.env"; if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path $f | Out-Null }
postCreateCommand: sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.claude backend/.venv frontend/node_modules && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && make setup && (sudo mv /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list.disabled 2>/dev/null || true) && npx -y playwright install --with-deps chrome
